changes.disclaimer: Statewide mean elevation above sea level, per USGS reference values. Some Plains states rank surprisingly high because their western edges climb toward the Rockies. Includes Washington DC.

'National Park' is a specific NPS designation — the broader 'National Park System' includes 400+ units (monuments, seashores, historic sites) but the traditional 'National Park' title is much rarer. Excludes national monuments, historic sites, seashores, and recreation areas. DC not included (source omits it).
National Forest acreage differs from BLM land — the Forest Service manages ~193M acres nationally. DC not included (source omits it).

Statewide average annual snowfall, averaged across the entire state's land area (NOAA 1991-2020 climate normals). Statewide averages differ substantially from 'snowiest cities' rankings because of how snowfall varies within a state. Includes Washington DC.
Statewide average annual mean temperature (Fahrenheit), NOAA 1991-2020 climate normals, averaged across the entire state's land area. Includes both non-contiguous states. Includes Washington DC.
Percent of adults (18+) with BMI >= 30 based on self-reported height/weight. Includes Washington DC.
Percent of adults (18+) who currently smoke cigarettes every day or some days. Includes Washington DC.
Age-adjusted deaths involving any opioid per 100,000 population, 2021. Includes Washington DC.
Age-adjusted suicide deaths per 100,000 population, 2021. Includes Washington DC.
Percent of nonelderly population without health insurance coverage. Includes Washington DC.
Renewables include hydro, wind, solar, geothermal, biomass. Percent of total in-state generation. Includes Washington DC.
Total utility-scale solar PV generation in gigawatt-hours (GWh), 2023. Includes Washington DC.
Total wind electricity generation in gigawatt-hours (GWh), 2023. DC not included (source omits it).
Metric tons of energy-related CO2 emissions per resident, 2021. Includes Washington DC.
Margin = winner percentage minus runner-up percentage. Includes Washington DC.
California is deliberately excluded to make the ranking competitive; measured in gallons produced. Includes Washington DC.
Federal civilian executive-branch employees per 10,000 residents; excludes military and postal service. Includes Washington DC.
Violent crime = murder, rape, robbery, aggravated assault. Per 100,000 population. Includes Washington DC.
Median gross rent (contract rent plus utilities) for renter-occupied housing units. Includes Washington DC.
All public roads (rural + urban, all functional classes) divided by state population, expressed per 1,000 residents. Includes Washington DC.
